name: se
description: Turn ideas into clear Feature plans, deliver them through reviewed pull requests, maintain project knowledge, and audit active work.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Features, deliver reviewed pull requests, and maintain project knowledge.
interface.longDescription: SE supports a complete software-delivery workflow. Learn maintains durable project knowledge and decisions. Idea captures proposals for later planning. Feature turns one or more source issues into an evidence-backed Feature Plan Set, with separate Feature issues, practical Macro Tasks, repository-sensitive dependency intent, mandatory best-effort native GitHub dependency projections backed by authoritative body relations, and optional label and native type classification delegated to G during publication. Implement selects Features only from caller-supplied GitHub issue references, never from labels or Issue Types, treats each parent Feature as the required semantic contract, treats native dependency state as non-blocking diagnostics, tolerates and reports partial or absent Macro Task projections, derives technical T-AC criteria without weakening F-AC, accepts an optional starting branch per target repository, refreshes and freezes its exact upstream tip before root Feature Worker worktrees start, delivers each Feature through a dedicated resumable worker, publishes concise durable PR bodies, starts stacked children from verified candidate-published parents, centrally monitors pull requests, CI, review feedback, and exact-head stack state, and leaves merge and post-merge closure to the user. Audit observes active SE work and reports problems or workflow improvements without making changes.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:learn to maintain durable repository knowledge, or $se:idea to save a proposal for later planning.

Use $se:feature to turn related requests into clear Feature issues and Macro Tasks, always attempt their native GitHub dependency projections without making provider failure a semantic gate, then delegate minimal optional issue labels and type without writing code.
Use $se:implement to deliver planned Features through reviewed pull requests, or $se:audit to observe active SE work without changing it.
